premises.text: Web3 game economies need tools so they do not crash once they have traction
premises.evidence_span: your biggest problem is how do I make sure my economy doesn't crash? How do I keep the economy healthy? And that's the problem that we help games to solve

premises.text: Platform features enact produce-and-tax principles via minigames, crafting, rewards, leaderboards, and security bots
premises.evidence_span: based on those two principles, we offer a variety of features on our platform that help games maintain healthy economies. So we have on-chain minigames, on-chain crafting, Minecraft style

premises.text: Monetize via $1000/month economy monitoring and $0.10 per infrastructure interaction
premises.evidence_span: we charge $1,000 per month to anyone who wants to know what's going on in an on-chain economy. And then for game projects, we charge as an infrastructure provider. We charge them $0.10 per interactions that their users make against our platform, against our smart contracts and our APIs
